name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-bros-grassland
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Bros. Grassland
description:
A reshaded and recolored version of the grassland tileset used in Super Mario Bros. (only the main tiles).
I modified the ledges, the background (clouds, hills), some blocks and the foreground. Flagpole and small castle are not included.

It includes an ExGFX file, a palette file, and 2 map16 files.
Please give credits if used.
